title: Keep conformance observations distinct from supplied judgments
statement: The Interpretation and validation Module shall present mechanical conformance findings and supplied engineering judgments as separate attributable accounts, preserving their exact bases and limitations without inferring approval or semantic adequacy.

what.problem: Whole-model checks and migration preparation can hide incomplete rules or alter meaning while appearing valid.
what.desired_outcome: Keep conformance observations distinct from supplied judgments.

why.rationale: SR-014 requires accountable diagnostics and candidate outcomes within MOD-003.

conditions: A participant requests selected-state conformance or an explicit model migration candidate.

contexts: MOD-003 logical request boundary and pure IF-002 operations over IF-001 captured input.

how.approach: Bind explicit source/profile/mapping scope, preserve all relevant findings and missingness, and return separate attributable mechanical, semantic and adoption limits.

how_much.scope: All parent SR-014 criteria for the selected finite model; capture custody, existing interpretation and later adoption retain their separate owners.

acceptance_criteria: Limit a mechanical conclusion to the named state, profile, rules and inspected scope; it cannot establish requirement approval, implementation or satisfaction.
Leave clarity, rationale, derivation and evidence adequacy to accountable engineering review even when the model is structurally valid.
Preserve each supplied judgment's subject, basis, assessor, purpose, conclusion and limitations; expose mismatch or unknown applicability rather than refreshing, merging or inventing approval.
Keep allocation questions without a deciding mechanical rule as review needs under MOD-004's existing contract, without fabricating a conflict or adequate design.
constraints: Proposed Design only; no product runtime, current migration support, implementation or verification is claimed.

sources.basis: Derive whole-model diagnostics, separate mechanical/review presentation and source-preserving explicit migration candidates through MOD-003. Reuse capture, interpretation and scoped-check ownership; proposed Design only.
